title: Destinal Orientation Question Bank
instructions: For each statement below, choose the number that best shows how much it sounds like you. There are no right or wrong answers — just answer honestly, based on how you usually feel and act, not how you think you should feel or act.

questions.text: I feel more comfortable when there is a clear plan or set of steps to follow.
I enjoy organising my books, room or timetable so that everything has its place.
I like fixing or building things with my hands, such as furniture, gadgets or models.
I get uncomfortable when tasks are left unfinished or done in the wrong order.
I am often the one who makes sure a group project has clear roles and a schedule.
I enjoy subjects like Mathematics or Design and Technology because they follow clear rules.
I often imagine new ideas, designs or stories in my mind.
I enjoy drawing, writing, composing music or making things that express how I feel.
I like finding new and original ways to do things instead of copying others.
I notice beauty in small details that other people often miss.
I feel most alive when I am creating something from nothing.
I enjoy subjects like Art, Literature or Music because they let me express myself.
I enjoy bringing different people together to work towards one goal.
I am good at seeing how different tasks or people fit together in a group project.
People often ask me to organise events, meetings or group activities.
I like making sure everyone in a team knows their role and works well with others.
I feel satisfied when many moving parts finally come together smoothly.
I enjoy being the person who links ideas, people or plans into one clear picture.
I ask a lot of 'why' and 'how' questions about the world around me.
I enjoy trying new activities, places or subjects even if I might fail.
I get excited when I learn something nobody around me knew before.
I enjoy science experiments or finding out how things work.
I would rather explore an unfamiliar topic than stick to what I already know.
I dream of travelling, researching or discovering something new one day.
I enjoy explaining things to classmates until they understand.
Friends often come to me for advice or to talk about their problems.
I feel good when I help someone discover a talent or ability they didn't know they had.
I am patient with people who are struggling to learn or understand something.
I like guiding younger students or siblings in their schoolwork or life choices.
I care more about helping someone grow than about being right myself.
I feel it is important to protect and take care of what already works well.
I get uncomfortable when people break rules or traditions without good reason.
I take my responsibilities and duties very seriously.
I feel called to protect people, animals or the environment from harm.
I respect discipline and order because they keep people safe.
I would rather maintain something valuable than change it too quickly.
I am not afraid to challenge the way things have always been done.
I have turned a difficult or painful experience into something that made me stronger.
I enjoy finding completely new solutions instead of small improvements.
I feel restless when things stay the same for too long.
I believe big change is sometimes necessary, even if it is uncomfortable.
People describe me as someone who reinvents themselves after setbacks.
